v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Tibi soli peccávi, * Dómine, miserére mei.
text.en: Before thee only have I sinned, * O Lord, have mercy on me.

text.la: Convértere, Dómine, * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
text.en: Turn thee again, O Lord, * and be gracious unto thy servants.
O God, * thou hast multiplied thy mercy.

text.la: Fortitúdo mea * et laus mea Dóminus: et factus est mihi in salútem.
text.en: The Lord is my strength * and my praise, and he is become my salvation.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum qui sanat contrítos corde, et álligat contritiónes eórum.
text.en: Praise the Lord * who healeth the broken of heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Egréssus Iesus * secéssit in partes Tyri et Sidónis: et ecce múlier Chananǽa a fínibus illis egréssa, clamábat dicens: Miserére mei, Fili David.
text.en: And Jesus went from thence * and retired into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon. And behold a woman of Canaan who came out of those coasts, crying out, said to him: Have mercy on me, O thou Son of David.

text.la: Devotiónem pópuli tui, quǽsumus, Dómine, benígnus inténde: ut, qui per abstinéntiam macerántur in córpore, per fructum boni óperis reficiántur in mente.
text.en: We beseech thee, O Lord, look with favor upon the devotion of Thy people, that they who mortify the body by abstinence, may be refreshed in mind by the fruit of good works.

text.la: Date ei de fructu mánuum suárum, et laudent eam in portis ópera eius.
text.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands, and let her own works praise her in the gates.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Deus, qui beátam Francíscam fámulam tuam, inter cétera grátiæ tuæ dona, familiári Angeli consuetúdine decorásti: concéde, quǽsumus; ut, intercessiónis eius auxílio, Angelórum consórtium cónsequi mereámur.
text.en: O God, Who along with other gifts of thy grace honored blessed Frances, thy handmaid, with the close companionship of an angel, grant, we beseech thee, that by the help of her intercession we may be made worthy to attain the companionship of angels.

office.title: Feria Quinta infra Hebd I in Quadr
